coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch completed with 12 targeted web searches. Coverage focused on only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss, disaster-related emergency food distribution cancellations, abrupt pantry or food-bank service closures/reductions, and immediate official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruptions. Fresh local reporting, official/provider notices, and direct-source-style results were prioritized. No new qualifying signal was identified since the prior hourly check; stale, duplicate, generic-policy, and non-immediate-access items were excluded.
